rules.description: TerraBase shape CDN (shapes-<bucket>): cache immutable TBS1 objects by path; errors are not cached
rules.expression: (starts_with(http.host, "shapes-") and ends_with(http.host, ".terrascale.tech") and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/shapes/") and http.request.uri.query eq "" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD" "PURGE"})

rules.description: TerraBase shape CDN (shapes-<bucket>): only GET/HEAD of v1/shapes objects, no query
rules.expression: (starts_with(http.host, "shapes-") and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/shapes/") or http.request.uri.path contains ".." or raw.http.request.uri.path contains ".." or raw.http.request.uri.path contains "%" or http.request.uri.query ne "" or not http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}))
